name: pale-supermodel-black-panther
image_purpose: fashion magazine key visual and campaign portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a dark elegant high-fashion editorial portrait pairing a composed model with a powerful black panther.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with a pale complexion, symmetrical double space buns, round black sunglasses, glossy black lipstick, a calm expression, and a black turtleneck. Behind her stands a realistic black panther wearing a generic diamond-style jeweled collar, presented as a controlled fashion-animal narrative with no contact or harm.
prompt.composition_elements: Tight portrait composition with the woman in the foreground and the panther rising behind her, deep red studio background, panther head and collar prominent on the left, model's face and sunglasses prominent on the right, bold balanced negative space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic directional lighting with cinematic contrast and sharp focus, controlled highlights on sunglasses and collar, dark elegant luxury-magazine atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-detail portrait, vertical editorial framing, realistic fur, jewelry, skin and textile texture, natural animal anatomy, no readable text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Dark elegant high-fashion editorial portrait of an adult fictional pale woman with symmetrical double space buns, round black sunglasses, glossy black lipstick, calm expression, and a black turtleneck. A realistic black panther stands behind her wearing a generic diamond-style jeweled collar in a controlled fashion-animal narrative. Bold red studio background, dramatic directional lighting, cinematic contrast, sharp focus, luxury fashion magazine aesthetic, ultra-detailed photorealistic texture, vertical composition.
